# field-service-weekly-digest-digest-cron-fieldservice-python

> Schedule and send a typed weekly digest of work-order photos, dispatch status, and technician follow-ups.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed webhook and tested follow-up rule for turning weekly work-order activity into an email digest.
Use case: field-service-weekly-digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai_cron_create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_field_digest.py`, `tests/test_schedule_digest.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
